name: Dijon Chicken Breasts
desc: Chicken simmered in a creamy Dijon pan sauce, done in one skillet

ingredients.raw: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (5 to 6 oz each)
ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken breasts (5 to 6 oz each)

ingredients.raw: 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream (or evaporated milk)
1/8 tsp dried thyme leaves, or 1 sprig fresh
ingredients.item: dried thyme leaves, or 1 sprig fresh

steps: Pound the chicken to 1 inch thickness and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side until browned and 165F inside. Remove and cover loosely with foil.
Add the butter and garlic to the same pan and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Deglaze with the white wine, scraping up the browned bits. Simmer about 3 minutes until reduced by half.
Whisk in the cream, broth, soy sauce, Dijon and thyme, and simmer 2 to 4 minutes until slightly thickened.
Return the chicken and its juices to the pan and heat through, about 2 minutes.
